text: Very bad experience. I came on one day to order breakfast and the lady told me they would open at 10 AM. Then I came back on a different day at 10:12 AM, and the same lady suddenly said they never serve breakfast at all. How can a big food court not serve breakfast, and why give customers wrong information? Very disappointing service and very poor communication.
author: Haze
